chunks: (So Abraham) said: "Then why do you worship something apart from God that cannot profit you or do you harm?"

key_terms.مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ: Apart from God / In place of God

ai.seo_question: Why did Abraham question his people about worshipping idols that cannot help or harm them?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-Anbiya, Prophet Abraham (peace be upon him) employs rational argumentation to dismantle the polytheistic belief in idols, a narrative central to Shia exegetical discussions on the unity of God (Tawhid) and the attributes of divine power. By highlighting the idols' inability to benefit or harm, the verse underscores the logical necessity of worshipping the All-Hearing and All-Knowing Creator, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on intellect (Aql) as a tool for recognizing divine truth.
